scope: Proposed roadmap from completed startup diagnostics through dual-arm cutting and later learning. Counts are not time estimates.

items.title: Confirm upgraded RAM and available GPU memory.
Add memory monitoring, bounded runtime and clean shutdown.
Launch Isaac Sim and complete the empty-scene startup check.
Run isolated blade/coupon initial and stationary checks.
Check blade distances/normals using precise reference queries.
Define contact coordinates, signs, weights and margin rules.
Build and check the contact snapshot adapter.
Verify actual native contact-buffer capture and overflow guards.
Generate and verify particle/edge/face contacts on an analytic box.
Check translated/rotated contact-record coordinates on that box.
Resolve force precision with separate geometry and arithmetic checks.
items.progress: Six native analytic fixtures pass under reference version 2. Historical combined gate remains failed and preserved.

items.title: Qualify the real blade's full-surface contact path.
items.progress: Authored-blade contact passes on the full tomato mesh, including force transfer, exact replay and clearing. Longer cuts remain unqualified.
checks: PASS — original blade geometry and finite-surface coverage
PASS — generated contact forces and exact replay

items.title: Verify particle/edge/face force distribution in stationary fixtures.
items.progress: Six native fixtures pass force and diagonal-stiffness scatter, color gating, spectator and algebraic reaction/moment checks. No integration.

items.title: Check dynamic momentum and work on minimal analytic fixtures.
items.progress: Two fresh one-step native fixtures pass: free particle/box recoil, momentum, impulse, discrete work/energy and clear control. Newton-internal coupling only.

items.title: Implement and validate Newton–Isaac/PhysX two-way coupling.
items.progress: Actual mounted-robot elastic-coupon exchange now passes 24 Newton/24 PhysX intervals: passive/driven response, off-center moments, exact loaded replay and clear control. Full-tomato coupling remains pending.
checks: PASS — full-mesh two-way force exchange
PASS — linear/angular balance and exact replay

items.title: Resolve the cohesive material solver/operator needed for cutting.
items.progress: Partial: moving-frame mixed-mode force, fracture potential and exact tangent pass independent checks on all 47 patches. Full-surface closure contact passes 18 geometry/force cases and 48 short gravity steps with replay. Partial-fracture/reclosure, blade eligibility and convergence remain open.
checks: PASS — independent mixed-loading, rigid-rotation and material tangent references
PASS — full-surface contact operator and short full-model gravity/replay component checks
OPEN — sustained dynamics, partial-fracture/reclosure, swept current-geometry eligibility and convergence

items.title: Validate material response against chosen reference measurements.
items.progress: Pending at your request. The published curve is a provisional reference; independent measurements are still needed.
checks: PENDING — independent experimental measurements

items.title: Verify damage, separation and post-cut contact on a small coupon.
items.progress: Small interface and solid coupons pass damage, separation, reclosure and replay. Whole-fruit post-cut behavior remains unqualified.
checks: PASS — fracture budget and irreversible failure
PASS — small-coupon reclosure and reset/replay

items.title: Verify robot, blade and target placement, units and coordinate frames.
items.progress: The original knife is mounted in a separate robot scene using SI units. The ideal fixed joint preserves the checked frames and adds no actuator joint.
checks: PASS — actual 36-joint robot; one active original knife
SCOPE — ideal massless mount; no finger-grasp claim

items.title: Verify target restraint/grasp and collision settings.
items.progress: Partial: ten-second gravity test failed settling; missing cut-face contact allowed the cap to pass through the remainder. Checked volume updates fix a separate rounding defect. Replacement contact passes short motion checks; sustained support is not yet qualified.
checks: PASS — 25 remainder fixture nodes; cap nodes remain free
PASS — board force/potential positive control and checked-volume regression
FAILED — previous ten-second settling test; evidence retained
OPEN — long support with new full-surface contact and bounded load challenge

items.title: Check approach, cutting and retreat motions without target contact.
items.progress: Two 8-second offset dry cycles pass approach, stroke and retreat under robot gravity. Minimum blade/target gap is 34.4 mm; blade/board clearance is 6.01 mm.
checks: PASS — rigid mount, bounded speed and tracking
PASS — no monitored forbidden contact forces; exact replay

items.title: Verify reset restores poses, velocities, contacts and material history.
items.progress: Partial: loaded elastic-coupon reset/replay with the actual mounted robot passes exactly. Integrated full-tomato and post-fracture reset remain untested.
checks: PASS — poses, velocities and both wrench queues
PASS — both target buffers, history and generated contact clearing

items.title: Run a slow, short cut with force, penetration and work logging.
items.progress: Prefracture integration: actual fixed-mount robot contact passes with a small elastic coupon. Short tomato cuts await the remaining material, support and coupled-work gates.

items.title: Verify meaningful separation without unstable or spurious forces.
items.progress: Verify complete mechanical disconnection, withdraw the blade and observe at least one second of independent motion with stable reclosure/board contact.

items.title: Check repeatability and sensitivity to time step/contact resolution.
items.progress: Check fresh/reset repeatability; refine time step, quadrature, solver and mesh separately. Report force, work, release and end-cap profile sensitivity.

items.title: Save a reproducible baseline scene, settings and results.
items.progress: Freeze the reproducible single-arm scene, controller, evaluator and traces; close the loaded post-cut reset gate.

items.title: Integrate the second arm and its grasp/support role.
items.progress: Keep the right fixed mount; qualify contact-based left-hand support under measured cutting loads and remove hidden fixture support.

items.title: Verify coordinated motion, mutual collisions and force transfer.
items.progress: Verify support handoff, synchronized force transfer, knife–hand clearance, disturbances and prechecked failure responses.

items.title: Repeat the controlled cutting baseline with both arms.
items.progress: Repeat paired fixture-versus-left-support cuts with unchanged right controller, quality/load/slip metrics and reproducible reset.

items.title: Finalize observations, actions, rewards and termination conditions.
items.progress: Bind the existing offline contracts to the qualified environment. Start with bounded draw/down residuals and verified observations; keep orientation locked.

items.title: Validate repeated resets and scripted baseline episodes.
items.progress: Verify success/failure/abort resets, no history leakage, frozen train/development/test cases and measured rollout cost.

items.title: Run a small training/evaluation pilot before longer experiments.
items.progress: Run a budgeted baseline-versus-residual pilot, multiple seeds and paired held-out cases; use uncertainty and compute cost to decide further experiments.

review.scope: Evidence/source review; no new native run. Historical component passes retained; broader integration gates reopened.

integration.scope: Prefracture integration only; no completed tomato cut or training
